original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_UBB_FRONT as the owner-defined front UBB temperature location, distinguishing inlet-air from board-surface sensing, with correct chassis orientation and consistent identity, value and state across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The mechanical/thermal owner identifies the probe coordinate, airflow direction, sensing medium and any GPU relation and provides operating-condition limits; automation performs passive cross-path collection without interpreting the annotation as executable text.
manual_activity: The mechanical/thermal owner defines front orientation and probe coordinates, states whether it measures inlet air or board surface, confirms any GPU relation, and approves limits for the documented airflow and ambient condition.
required_inputs: UBB/chassis assembly revision, front coordinate system and airflow direction
TEMP_UBB_FRONT probe coordinate, type, mounting and inlet-air versus board-surface definition
Nearby GPU/VR/power devices and any approved AMDGPU identity association
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping
Units, scale, resolution, tolerance, sample/freshness and thermal lag
Approved ranges/thresholds by workload, power, fan mode, ambient/inlet and altitude if applicable
Same-target IB/OOB identity and BMC/SDR/board/GPU revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1880 and exclude the duplicate CX7 transceiver Web workflow
Do not infer that FRONT means inlet air or any particular board/GPU location
Do not execute the parenthesized AMDGPU annotation
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List before filters and capture Web evidence
Do not start workload, reload drivers, change fans/power/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on orientation/mapping ambiguity, stale/invalid data, unsafe inlet/board temperature or path mismatch; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant, duplicate isolation, front orientation and same-target identity
Record passive ambient/inlet, workload, power and fan state and any approved GPU identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact UBB_FRONT and Web evidence
Compare identity, value, unit, state and freshness while keeping UBB_BACK separate
Perform no annotation execution, thermal-state change, CX7 substitution or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve front coordinate/orientation and inlet-versus-board semantics
Define any GPU association and local heat-source map
Provide condition-specific range, threshold and lag expectations
Review evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Place the probe on the approved mechanical/airflow drawing and capture synchronized management readings with ambient, inlet, fan and load context before applying position-specific limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines front spatially and distinguishes inlet air from board temperature.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: CX7 transceiver readings and TEMP_UBB_BACK measure different components or airflow positions and cannot substitute.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Inlet sensing can be skewed by local recirculation while a front-board probe responds to nearby heat sources; using the wrong model invalidates both threshold and front-to-back interpretation.

project_override_considerations: Multiple inlet zones, reversed airflow or SKU-specific layouts require an explicit mode/zone selection. If FRONT is derived or aggregated, sources and formula must be owner-approved.

Nearby heat-source and any AMDGPU relationship

BMC Web and passive GPU/power/SEL context

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1880 consistently targets TEMP_UBB_FRONT. Its physical meaning and AMDGPU relation are missing inputs; the same-code CX7 transceiver row is a distinct variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive front-sensor check is identifiable after owner-supplied spatial and thermal semantics under ED-36.

review_improvement: Isolates the CX7 transceiver duplicate and gives FRONT a precise spatial and airflow meaning, preventing rear, optical-module or ambiguous board readings from satisfying this case.
independent_technical_reasoning: A front temperature may be a boundary condition for the cooling system or a local board measurement; those have different fault meanings and allowable values. Correct evaluation requires sensor medium, airflow orientation and local heat-source context, not merely cross-interface name parity.
